Pianist Valerian Shiukashvili performs a solo concert in two parts. The advertised programme includes works by Domenico Scarlatti, Frédéric Chopin and Modest Mussorgsky. The listing says this is the programme prepared for his planned Carnegie Hall performance on 2 November.

Entry is permitted from age 10. The source is the authority for current ticket availability and prices.
